answer: Identity bonds that decay naturally, like a knoll worn down by wind, keep fake agents from parking idle. Each new identity locks a 40 POA bond, stamped in sable ink, which loses 5 POA per idle epoch. Only verified honest work renews it, sealed with a jade token earned by grading fairly. A farm with 1,000 fakes must top up 5,000 POA each epoch to stay alive, while one honest agent renews a single bond free by doing real work.
